successors.name: Pagan Kingdom
successors.text: Thaton and Lower Burma (Ramannadesa): a Mon kingdom 'essentially a city-state centered on the city of Thaton' on the Gulf of Martaban

ledger.x: c. 825: the Mon kingdom of Thaton. The page says it 'probably came into existence some time in the 9th century' and its Mon kingdoms timeline reads 825?-1057?; Harvey's 825 for Pegu (Shwemawdaw Thamaing) 'remains unattested'. Tradition dates the kingdom to the 6th century BCE, which the page does not accept as history.
1057: the Mon kingdom of Thaton ends.

wars.name: Pagan conquest of Thaton
wars.outcome: Pagan takes Thaton after a three-month siege, reportedly on 17 May 1057, and Lower Burma passes to Pagan.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the extent is the whole of Lower Burma as the pagan-kingdom dossier takes it.
